Python 3.11 plugin engine. Supports .plugin, .py and Elyx ZIP archives. Basic exteraGram lifecycle, settings storage, request hooks and outgoing-message hooks are available. Xposed hooks, plugin menu injection, wheels and PIP dependencies are not supported yet.
Plugins are executable code and receive the same Telegram data and permissions as wgtg. Install only code you trust. A malicious plugin can read messages or send requests as you.
Sender name colors in chats are only visible on this device. Chroma cycles the hue; RGB animates a rainbow. Names with bot attribution keep their original style.

For this account: saves cached incoming cloud messages when a remote deletion arrives, plus fully downloaded media. Open files with a compatible viewer. Secret chats and disappearing media are excluded. Previously deleted or unavailable content cannot be recovered. Copies remain until you clear the archive or log out.
